F1: Concurrent builds can publish separate indexes, allowing an event update to be lost when another build replaces its index.
F2: TotalDocs` iterates the cache without a lock while the event consumer can write to it, risking a race or crash.
F3: Requests no longer check lifecycle state, so authenticated CRUD calls can still reach the backend after `Stop`.
F4: Disabling PostgreSQL integration coverage is a test-coverage concern, not a demonstrated runtime defect.
